page.layout: One printed page: title block centred at top; below it a heading line "Ante diluuium uixerunt"; then a genealogical table of three columns (name, years from creation, age at death); closing lines at foot; signature "A" and catchword "Post" at lower right. No margin notes. Digitiser's URL at bottom is omitted.
page.head: SERIES ASTROLOGORVM A PRIMIS PATRIBVS AD NOSTRVM SECVLVM VSQVE, ID EST, AD ANNVM A NATO SALVATORE DOMINO NOSTRO IHESV CHRISTO 1550, A CONDITO MVNDO 5512.
Ante diluuium uixerunt
page.p: Anno 600 ætatis Nohæ, Mundi uero 1656 cepit diluuium.
page.notes: The numerals of the title and table are old-style figures in a decorative face (e.g. "5512" = 1552? printed as 5512 in the scan and kept as shown; "1550" is set in the same face). Initial "A" of the table is a large woodcut-style letter joined to "Dam". Column 2 years and column 3 ages are read from the printed figures; some digits in the decorative numeral face are uncertain and may be misread: "1042" and "1039" in particular. The name "Mahalalel" is overprinted by "Nati an." and is partly illegible.
